weaknesses: The abstract does not clearly articulate the limitations of the Polyak-Łojasiewicz condition, which may mislead readers about the generality of the results.
The experimental section lacks a comparison with other implicit regularization methods, which would strengthen the empirical support for the claims made.
Numerical experiments do not sufficiently explore the impact of different activation functions beyond the GELU, limiting the scope of the findings.
strengths: The paper provides a solid mathematical foundation linking deep residual networks to neural ODEs, addressing a significant gap in the literature.
The proof of the implicit regularization effect is rigorous and well-structured, enhancing the theoretical contribution of the work.
Numerical experiments effectively illustrate the theoretical results, showcasing the practical implications of the findings.
